SELECT
  d.doctor_id,
  d.doctor_name,
  d.department,
  d.specialization,
  d.consultation_duration,
  d.available_from,
  d.available_to,
  ds.day_of_week,
  ds.start_time,
  ds.end_time,
  ds.is_available
FROM doctors d
LEFT JOIN doctor_schedule ds
  ON d.doctor_id = ds.doctor_id
  AND ds.day_of_week = '{{ $('Prepare Slot Request Input').item.json.day_of_week }}'
WHERE d.doctor_id = {{ $('Prepare Slot Request Input').item.json.doctor_id }}
AND d.is_active = TRUE
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  appointment_id,
  TIME(appointment_start) AS booked_start,
  TIME(appointment_end) AS booked_end,
  status
FROM appointments
WHERE doctor_id = {{ $('Prepare Slot Request Input').item.json.doctor_id }}
AND appointment_date = '{{ $('Prepare Slot Request Input').item.json.appointment_date }}'
AND status IN ('scheduled', 'confirmed', 'checked_in')
ORDER BY appointment_start ASC;

SELECT
  unavailable_id,
  doctor_id,
  unavailable_date,
  TIME_FORMAT(start_time, '%H:%i') AS start_time,
  TIME_FORMAT(end_time, '%H:%i') AS end_time,
  reason
FROM doctor_unavailability
WHERE doctor_id = {{ $('Prepare Slot Request Input').item.json.doctor_id }}
AND unavailable_date = '{{ $('Prepare Slot Request Input').item.json.appointment_date }}';
